newsitem.title: USA: AirWays sees Q2 loss topping forecasts.
newsitem.headline: AirWays sees Q2 loss topping forecasts.

text.p: AirWays Corp said on Monday that its second quarter loss for the period ending September 30 may range between $0.40 and $0.45 a share, which is below analysts' expectations.
Analysts had expected a loss of about $0.03 a share, according to First Call. In last year's second quarter, the company posted a profit of $0.02 a share.
As anticipated, second quarter operating results have been adversely affected by significant expenses related to efforts aimed at strengthening the airline's operational reliability.
Airways said it anticipates steadily improving operating results in the second half of the year, with a narrowed loss in the third quarter and a return to profitability in the fourth quarter.
Also, AirWays is suspending flights on some routes that have not met specified revenue and profit targets.

The carrier is suspending service from Orlando to Dallas and Birmingham, Ala. Later this year, AirWays said it plans to withdraw service from Orlando to Nashville; Providence, R.I.; and Hartford, Conn.
The company said it plans to add Chattanooga, Tenn. and Toledo, Ohio to its routes from Orlando.
AirWays said it is modernizing its fleet of ten Boeing 737-200s by including hush kits and improving the interiors of the planes.
